h08.

Two types declare `RunOnce`, both in the background-runner layer:

**`memopayload.Runner.RunOnce`** — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` — **not invoked** — no caller

**`s3presign.Runner.RunOnce`** — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43` — **invoked, from production code** — two callers:
- `s3presign.Runner.Run` — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36` (per-tick call inside the runner's ticker loop)
- `server.Server.startBackgroundRunners` — `server/server.go:163` (eager one-shot pass at startup, before the continuous `Run` goroutine is launched at `server/server.go:169`)

Detail worth noting on the memopayload declarer: the map returns a **certified zero** for its callers — the widening probes across view, depth, and kind found nothing either. A text search across all `*.go` files agrees: the only two occurrences of the token in that file are the doc comment (`runner.go:26`) and the declaration itself (`runner.go:27`), with no call site in test files or any `main` package. So it is dead code, not merely test-only code — the type is a payload-rebuild backfill utility that nothing currently wires into startup, in contrast to the `s3presign` runner which `startBackgroundRunners` both primes once and then drives on a ticker.
